title: Countable extraction from a finitely presented Mittag-Leffler presentation
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, let $I$ be a small nonempty directed partially ordered set, and let $(M_i,f_{ij})_{i\in I}$ be a directed system of finitely presented $R$-modules. A module is finitely presented here if it is the cokernel of an $R$-linear map $R^a\to R^b$ for finite integers $a,b\ge0$. Let $M$ be an $R$-module with compatible maps $M_i\to M$ identifying $M$ with the colimit [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] of this system. Assume $M$ is Mittag-Leffler [def-trf-mittag-leffler-module] and has an at most countable subset whose finite $R$-linear combinations exhaust $M$. There is a nonempty countable directed subset $J\subseteq I$, with the inherited order, such that the canonical map $\operatorname{colim}_{i\in J}M_i\to M$ is an isomorphism.

source.place: Tag 059W (lemma-ML-countable-colimit); the module notion is identified with the tensor condition by Tag 059M (proposition-ML-tensor).

proof.text: Let $E\subseteq M$ be the given at most countable generating set, allowing $E=\varnothing$ when $M=0$, and write $u_i:M_i\to M$ for the colimit maps. By [lem-weil-pbc-filtered-colimit-modules-elementwise], for each $x\in E$ choose $i(x)\in I$ and $y_x\in M_{i(x)}$ with $u_{i(x)}(y_x)=x$. Choose $i_*\in I$ and put $S_0=\{i_*\}\cup\{i(x):x\in E\}$. This is a countable nonempty set of indices containing representatives of every generator.

source.place: Tag 059W, proof, first paragraph (choice of countable generators and stage representatives)

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-mittag-leffler-hom-systems] with $N=P=\prod_{s\in I}M_s$: its statement allows every $R$-module $N$, with no finiteness restriction. Its image-stabilization conclusion is exactly the hypothesis of [lem-trf-hom-product-stabilization-factorization]. The latter gives, for every $i$, an index $s(i)\ge i$ such that $f_{i,s(i)}$ factors through every $f_{ik}$ with $k\ge i$. Choose one such $s(i)$ for each $i$.

source.place: Tags 059M and 059E, proposition-ML-characterization, proof of (5) implies (3); the common-upper-bound argument for incomparable indices is carried by the extracted product-Hom factorization lemma.

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-countable-directed-function-closure] to $I$, the function $s$ of Step 2 and $S_0$. It gives a countable nonempty directed subset $J\supseteq S_0$ with $s(J)\subseteq J$. Consequently every $i\in J$ has $j=s(i)\in J$, $j\ge i$, for which $f_{ij}$ factors through $f_{ik}$ for every $k\in I$ with $k\ge i$.

source.place: Tag 059W, proof, second through fourth paragraphs (successive countable sets, directed closures, and their union)

proof.text: For every $x\in E$, Step 1 supplies its representative at $i(x)\in S_0\subseteq J$. For $i\in J$, take $j=s(i)\in J$ from Step 3. If $f_{ik}(y)=0$, the factorization $f_{ij}=h\circ f_{ik}$ gives $f_{ij}(y)=h(0)=0$; hence $\ker(f_{ik})\subseteq\ker(f_{ij})$ for every $k\ge i$. All hypotheses of [lem-trf-restricted-colimit-generators-kernels] hold for this same $E$, so the canonical restricted-colimit map is an isomorphism. The argument permits $E=\varnothing$.

source.place: Tag 059W, proof, properties (2),(3) and final two paragraphs; apply the extracted restricted-colimit criterion.

proof_origin.place: Tag 059W (lemma-ML-countable-colimit), with the tensor-product ML-to-factorization step from Tags 059M and 059E
